title: The Missing Will
author: Odile Almeida
blurb: Lena Sterling, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
